description: data/ui/strings.json (Phase C): the global UI string table for text that is NOT one fixed label per widget id (that's the per-widget `label` override, data/schemas/ui_screen.schema.json) — text that varies by runtime/enum state or is built from a template with values. A FLAT {string_id: template} map, one dotted id per source module/call-site (hud.*, widgets.*, levelup.*, boss_cutscene.*). Loaded once at boot (game/main.py) and passed to game.ui.strings.configure_strings, which rebinds the string table in place; every call site resolves text via game.ui.strings.T(string_id, **kwargs) = template.format(**kwargs). The unconfigured module defaults equal this file's stock content. Templates use Python str.format() placeholders — each property's description documents which keyword(s) its call site passes. All keys are required: the game names them by id, so a missing one would raise KeyError at the T() call site; adding a NEW id is a schema change (a closed set, same convention as fonts.json/palette.json).

boss_cutscene.headline_loss.description: Boss-cutscene headline shown on a LOST boss round. No placeholders (win/loss is a 2-variant runtime pick, not part of the template).

boss_cutscene.headline_win.description: Boss-cutscene headline shown on a WON boss round. No placeholders.

hud.income.base.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip category label for the base per-round income source. No placeholders.

hud.income.meditators.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip category label for meditator-building income. No placeholders.

hud.income.musicians.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip category label for musician-building income. No placeholders.

hud.income.story.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip category label for boss-bonus story income. No placeholders.

hud.income.upkeep.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip category label for total building upkeep (a negative source). No placeholders.

hud.income_net.description: HUD top-left net income-per-round line. Placeholders: {sign} ('+' or ''), {net} (the signed integer amount).

hud.level.description: HUD village-level readout beside the XP bar. Placeholder: {n} (the village level, int).

hud.lightning_cooldown.description: HUD lightning readout while the strike is cooling down. Placeholder: {seconds} (the remaining cooldown, pre-formatted to one decimal place by the caller).

hud.lightning_ready.description: HUD lightning readout when a strike is ready to fire. No placeholders.

hud.lives.description: HUD lives readout. Placeholder: {count} (remaining base lives, int).

hud.love_display.description: HUD love-pill count (also used for the affordable hover-cost preview). Placeholder: {amount} (the love count, int).

hud.love_unaffordable.description: HUD love-pill display when a hovered action's cost would take love negative. No placeholders.

hud.phase.boss_cutscene.description: HUD phase-banner text while GamePhase.BOSS_CUTSCENE is active. No placeholders.

hud.phase.building.description: HUD phase-banner text while GamePhase.BUILDING is active. No placeholders.

hud.phase.enemy.description: HUD phase-banner text while GamePhase.ENEMY is active. No placeholders.

hud.phase.income.description: HUD phase-banner text while GamePhase.INCOME is active. No placeholders.

hud.phase.levelup.description: HUD phase-banner text while GamePhase.LEVELUP is active. No placeholders.

hud.phase.round_end.description: HUD phase-banner text while GamePhase.ROUND_END is active. No placeholders.

hud.round.description: HUD round-number readout above the End Turn button. Placeholder: {n} (the current round number, int).

hud.round_tutorial.description: HUD round readout during the tutorial's own scripted round (round 0) — shown instead of hud.round. No placeholders.

hud.tiles.description: HUD built/unlocked tile-count readout. Placeholders: {built} (built tile count, int), {unlocked} (unlocked tile count, int).

hud.tooltip_income.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip row for a positive, non-upkeep/story source. Placeholders: {label} (the source's own resolved category label, e.g. 'Base'/'Musicians'), {amount} (the amount, int).

hud.tooltip_story.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip row for boss-bonus story income. Placeholder: {amount} (the amount, int).

hud.tooltip_upkeep.description: HUD income-breakdown tooltip row for total upkeep. Placeholder: {amount} (the upkeep amount — already negative, int).

hud.xp_progress.description: HUD XP-bar progress readout. Placeholders: {current} (player XP, int), {threshold} (XP needed for the next level, int).

levelup.cost_free.description: Level-up option-box cost line when the option's cost is zero or less. No placeholders.

levelup.cost_paid.description: Level-up option-box cost line when the option has a real cost. Placeholders: {label} (the option's own cost label), {cost} (the cost amount, int).

levelup.heading.description: Level-up modal's fixed heading, above the option boxes. No placeholders.

levelup.tier_progress.description: Level-up option-box tier-progress line, tier-kind options only. Placeholders: {tier_no} (the tier this option advances TO, int), {tier_max} (the family's highest tier, int).

widgets.condition.forest.description: Display label for the FOREST tile condition (10I terrain badges/tooltips, map overlays). No placeholders.

widgets.condition.grass.description: Display label for the GRASS tile condition. No placeholders.

widgets.condition.mountain.description: Display label for the MOUNTAIN tile condition. No placeholders.

widgets.condition.pond.description: Display label for the POND tile condition. No placeholders.
